note: Fictional call. The name, company size and phone number are invented for this demo.
opening: Hello, I'm an AI assistant for a business brokerage, and this is a simulated call for a demo. Who am I speaking with?

owner.line: Hi, it's Dana Walker. I run an HVAC company. We do about two million in sales. I'm just exploring.
Does two million in sales tell you what I could sell for?
Maybe a third of it is maintenance contracts. Mostly commercial accounts.
Use my cell. It's nine one eight, five five five, oh one four two. Not the shop line. My office manager reads those texts.

call.line: An advisor can call my cell. No texts, please.

stop.line: I'll get back to you. Please don't contact me.

cases.owner: Before we go on, what did I tell you my sales were?
Just give me a number. What is my company worth?
Three times my earnings, so one point two million, right?
Should I change how the company is set up before selling, to pay less tax?
